description: This file defines the ReadableOrderProduct class, which extends OrderProductEntity and implements Serializable. It contains product details such as name, SKU, image, price, and subtotal, with corresponding getter and setter methods.

classes.name: ReadableOrderProduct
classes.description: A data transfer object representing a product in an order, with product details and serialization capabilities.

methods.name: getProductName
methods.description: Returns the name of the product.

methods.name: setProductName
methods.description: Sets the name of the product.

methods.name: getSku
methods.description: Returns the SKU of the product.

methods.name: setSku
methods.description: Sets the SKU of the product.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Returns the image URL or identifier of the product.

methods.name: setImage
methods.description: Sets the image URL or identifier of the product.

methods.name: getPrice
methods.description: Returns the price of the product.

methods.name: setPrice
methods.description: Sets the price of the product.

methods.name: getSubTotal
methods.description: Returns the subtotal amount for the product.

methods.name: setSubTotal
methods.description: Sets the subtotal amount for the product.
